jobs.title: CAD Administrator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Role**

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
* Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
* Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
* Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
* Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
* Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
* Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
* Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
* Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
* CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
* Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
* Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
* Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
* Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
* Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
* Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

#### **Job Summary**

The Research Assistant in Scientific Computing will work at the AI+Science Lab led by Prof. Anima Anandkumar at Caltech, a mission-driven multidisciplinary environment creating cutting-edge AI methods and applying them to a wide range of scientific domains, ranging from weather/climate modeling, material design and manufacturing, protein design, and autonomous drone flights.

The Research Assistant is responsible for gathering accurate, credible information on a subject and summarizing their findings to support senior research staff in scientific and academic fields. Their duties include browsing archives for information, completing literature reviews, and conducting research interviews. The successful candidate will perform a variety of duties to help with the publication of work.

#### **Essential Job Duties**

* Maintaining quality control standards to preserve the integrity of data and findings.
* Scheduling and conducting interviews.
* Selecting a place to conduct interviews and getting permission from all participants.
* Analyzing data using various statistical methods.
* Writing reports to summarize data and the implications of the results.
* Researching information.
* Gathering accurate, credible information on a subject.
* Summarizing findings to support senior research staff.
* Browsing archives for information.
* Completing literature reviews.
* Preparing scientific equipment or setting up experiments to test hypotheses.
* Recording data or collecting samples in order to track the progress of experiments over time.
* Creating graphs, charts, tables, and other visual representations of data.
* Planning research projects.
* Writing proposals and grant applications.
* Developing statistical models.
* Analyzing data.
* Producing reports.
* Presenting research findings.

#### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
* 3 years of relevant scientific research experience.
* Strong mathematical fundamentals and algorithm skills or experience.
* Excellent programming, debugging, performance analysis, and test design skills.
* Ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication and documentation habits.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
* Moderate research project experience doing performance analysis and tuning.
* Moderate research project experience training large-scale foundation models, especially pipeline/model parallelism.
* Track record of creating HPC software for numerical methods.
* Domain expertise in areas like computational fluid dynamics, material deformation, wave propagation, etc.
* Familiarity with containers, numeric libraries, modular software design.
* Experience doing performance analysis and tuning.
* Excellent C/C++ and Python programming skills.
* GPU programming (CUDA) would be welcome.

#### **Required Documents**

* Resume

----------------

$25.75 to $32.00 per hour  
  
The salary of the finalist(s) selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Finance Data Analyst to join our Corporate Finance Investments team based out of our Santa Clara campus. As an integral member of the team, our organization’s overarching responsibilities are to provide the highest caliber of relevant financial and business information that is both informative and measurable, enabling effective decision-making at all levels of the Company and improving our financial performance. This is a critical position within the Finance organization, requiring deep finance analytics experience, advanced automation and data skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver to Company’s timelines. We are looking for an upbeat individual who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced and execution-oriented environment passionate about achieving goals, and with good communication skills.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Act as a translator and steward of operating expense, capital, headcount and purchase order data, guiding users to understand and properly leverage data sources / solutions.
* Develop, prototype, build and maintain data solutions by using SQL, AI and BI Tools, financial reporting standards, and database management experience.
* Develop AI agents that automate finance processes, collect and transform data, and produce reporting/analysis while maintaining high quality.
* Manage multiple workstreams, assess risks/issues and deliver solutions on time.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure and meet performance requirements. Support solutions through monitoring data quality, enhancing solutions, resolving issues and training end-users.
* Collaborate with multi-functional teams to find opportunities for process optimization, building consensus, automation, and cost reduction.

**What we need to see:**

* 5+ years of experience in FP&A, working closely with business partners from multiple departments. Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Python, AI Tools (Claude, Cursor and/or ChatGPT Work), Tableau or Power BI. Strong data modeling skills in SQL is essential.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science or Engineering. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
* End-user focused and experienced in delivering game-changing AI and data solutions.
* Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, simultaneously manage several priorities, and challenge the status quo to drive change and operational improvement.
* Superb communication and interpersonal skills demonstrating ability to build successful relationships.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with operating expense, capital, headcount or purchase order data.
* Strong ownership ethic and intense focus on accuracy and accountability; take pride of work quality, strive for improvements; operate with strong team-work spirit..
* Experience automating finance workflows beyond Excel by developing agents and skills using Claude Code, ChatGPT Work, Cursor, Python and SQL.
* Knowledge or experience in SAP S4, SAP BPC, SAP HANA and Databricks.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 3, and 144,000 USD - 230,000 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

new_jobs.description:
**Title: Lab Technician**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA(Onsite)**

**Type: 6+ Month Contract**

**Rate: $Open /hr.**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a **Lab / Data Center Technician** with 1–3 years of experience in a laboratory or data center environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with equipment rack and stack, network cabling, device auditing, basic networking, VMware, Windows, and Linux administration. The candidate should also have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage ticket queues and respond to requests within SLA requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Enable remote access to lab services for end users through **SSL VPN, RDP, VNC, and View Client**.
* Perform **rack and stack** activities for network and lab equipment.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and presentable lab environment.
* Identify different types of network cables, connectors, and their appropriate applications.
* Audit physical and virtual devices, including **connections, serial numbers, and IP addresses**.
* Maintain and update lab and infrastructure documentation.
* Act as a **ticket queue lead**, monitoring incoming tickets and assigning or reassigning tickets to appropriate team members or groups.
* Review incoming requests and ticket updates daily and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Build and cable network topologies based on requirements from Engineers and Lab Administrators.
* Monitor **power and cooling usage** within the lab and identify potential issues.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of network outages and connectivity issues.
* Use **SSH and console access** to connect to network devices.
* Follow established SLA requirements and prioritize tickets appropriately.
* Communicate clearly through email, messaging, and ticket updates.
* Maintain strong follow-up and responsiveness to user and engineering requests.
* Follow proper safety and equipment-handling procedures, including the ability to lift equipment weighing **50+ lbs.**

  
  
**Requirements**  

* 2 **–3 years of experience** working in a **lab, data center, network operations, or similar technical environment**
* Basic network troubleshooting skills.
* Basic experience working with **firewalls**.
* Hands-on experience with **Cisco and/or Arista switches** is preferred.
* Basic **Windows administration** experience.
* Basic **VMware** administration, including powering VMs on/off.
* Basic experience with **CentOS, Ubuntu, or other Linux distributions**.
* Strong understanding of **copper and fiber-optic cabling**.
* Experience with **fiber and copper cable installation and management** in a data center environment.
* Strong understanding of **patch panels and cable connections**.
* Ability to identify and manage different cable types and connections.
* Familiarity with SSL VPN, RDP, VNC, and remote-access technologies.
* Ability to SSH and console into network devices.
* Understanding of basic **power and cooling requirements** in a lab/data center.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Research Associate

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
